BL-1765 — A closing ceremony in progress at local midnight finishes under the night it started - night-closing-ceremony-run.ts re-derives nightKey from each tick's calendar day, so a sleep that starts the ceremony shortly before midnight abandons that night on its next tick and freezes promotion again for a new one (the first night's briefing is never asked for, the drain runs twice); a night in progress keeps its day up to its own sleep ceiling, and past that ceiling or once done the calendar day decides as before
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: New feature file and a behaviour change in the live ceremony runner. FIRM: the bound. A night in progress keeps the day it started under only up to its own hard deadline plus SLEEP_CEILING_GRACE_MS (the ceiling the sleep loop already gives up at). It is deliberately NOT a longer window such as 24 h…
BL-1765 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1765" (or "reject BL-1765 <reason>") to act.
